inputs.plan_text: Required rich plan text with 10+ non-empty lines unless plan_file is provided.
inputs.plan_file: Optional path to a detailed plan file when inline plan_text is not provided.
inputs.channel: Required package channel: released or beta.
inputs.language: Optional language surface for package and guide links: en or zh-cn. If omitted, the current public guide surface defaults to en, so callers should pass zh-cn explicitly when they need Chinese guide links and should pass --lang <language> when invoking the guide command.

default_assumptions.package_index_source: The source of truth for acquiring the AO package is the absolute URL of the released or beta package index page that matches the chosen language surface.
default_assumptions.runtime_bundle_restore: When AO execution needs local NuGet acquisition, restore the AO runtime bundle instead of only the AO package: Techne.Loom.AgentOrchestrator, Techne.Loom.Common, and Techne.Loom.Abstractions, all at the same resolved channel/version.
default_assumptions.target_product_rule: Any AO skill or target product that adopts Loom-bin-based skills must preserve released and beta package index absolute URLs in its own skill or product-facing docs, using localized mirrors when the product exposes localized package index pages.
default_assumptions.guide_authority: The skill should treat dotnet ao.dll --guide [--lang <language>] as the authoritative runtime surface instead of copying a private execution template.
default_assumptions.cli_only_surface: AO is CLI-only in this project. Do not rely on MCP hosts or MCP tools.
default_assumptions.dll_interface_mapping: Use only the public AO CLI surface from the selected channel guide: dotnet ao.dll --guide [--lang <language>], compile, run, and resume.

outputs.package_index_link: Absolute URL to the released or beta package index page that matches the chosen language surface.
outputs.package_index_links: Released/beta package index absolute URL set, including localized mirrors when they exist.
outputs.runtime_bundle_packages: AO runtime bundle package list used for local acquisition: Techne.Loom.AgentOrchestrator, Techne.Loom.Common, and Techne.Loom.Abstractions.
outputs.dll_interface_mapping: Confirmed mapping between the skill runtime flow and AO public CLI commands used by the selected channel guide.
outputs.workflow_file: Runtime workflow file path returned by AO, plus any optional agent-authored workflow input path used only for compile validation.
outputs.audit_artifacts: Mermaid Markdown, HTML, and workflow JSON backup links.
